none: PAS LANCUM-1DA6B1: copper alloy Roman coin
contea di ritrovamento: Lancashire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ is ]DOMIT AVG[ ; R/ is FORTVNAE

Roman copper alloy coin, probably a dupondius of Domitian dating from c85 AD (Reece Period 4). Cf RIC 2(2) (Domitian), 291. The diameter is 26mm and the weight 4.80g. Obverse inscription is ]DOMIT AVG[. Reverse inscription is FORTVNAE. The coin is damaged & corroded
